t:
Oh, that's a nasty place. I remember telling my kids stories about beautiful and terrifying sirens who lured poor sailors with their enchanting songs. Who knew those stories were going to come true?

Astralonauts say that the whole place in overwhelmed with shipwrecks. When they flied by, they locked all the crew in the hold. Only the toughest stayed on the deck. The navigator even plugged his ears with wax to avoid temptation. They say, the song is really beautiful. So beautiful it makes you want to jump off the ship.

It is madness, for sure. This is why we have to end it. Be careful if you fly that way. The sailors said they saw the undead and strangely looking Elves on the isle. That must be Elven women who sing the songs!

Hm... I heard of a small allod, lost deep in the Astral. I've never been there actually. They say sinister things about it. Ships get lost... One friend of mine told me that when a ship approaches that island, its devices start to hiccup and the reactor boils!

And there's more. Once I met a drunken orc who claimed that once he was a cook on an Imperial trading ship, which crashed at that very allod. He spoke of the undead, of savages that eat humans, and of an ugly idol... Honestly, I didn't pay much attention to his drunken gibberish, but if you ever moor your ship to that allod, don't let go of your weapon!
What is it you would like to know about?
r415425.n: Ask about the allods in Far Astral

But I still love him! If I had to do it all again, I'd do the same thing. And you... You killed Alister! You killed my beloved one! And now you have to die!

I loved Alister... I was ready to do anything for his love!

I turned Mstislav into a werewolf to keep the peasants in their homes even when the sun is up. My beloved one can't stand the daylight!

"...reactor is dead... ttacked the rock... four surviv..."

"...one more ship... hull is crushed... killed everyone! They killed everyone! Damn savag..."

"...saw my friend... dea... came for me!"

t:
Do you want to feel the taste of real Skirmishes? Battles, where not only rough force matters, but also thoughtful tactical planning?

Then you belong on Dominion, where the best guild raids battle for the Astral treasures! The more successful your guild is, the more Realgar it gets as the reward. And the more is your personal benefit!

First of all, we are talking about the second rank equipment, also known as Precious Equipment. You can identify it by the number II on each item. Unlike the first rank that can be found anywhere, or the third one that is really hard to get, the second rank requires only patience and persistence, along with a handful of resources.

First of all, you will need boxes with loot. You can find them everywhere: on astral allods, in Skirmishes, in raid adventures. There's plenty! I'll give you one from my personal stash for teaching purposes.

These boxes contain fragments of equipment. They will require some work before you can turn them into something suitable. You'll need tools for that. The better your tools and fragments, the more material you will get, which means you can craft a full set of equipment sooner! There are different tools. You can buy common tools for gold. You can craft yourself better tools or get them from the Boutique or by participating in Skirmishes. Participants of the Guild Dominion can receive the best tools! You should try out different tools and see for yourself.

You will also need a suitable workpiece. It can be crafted by a member of a Profession or purchased from other players.

Once you have the workpiece and materials, all you need to do is craft the equipment! It's simple: the anvil will do everything for you. You just need a bit of gold.
r445777.n: Brush up on equipment crafting basics

t:
To craft a Hero’s Insignia, you need Enchanted Dust and Amalgam. Enchanted Dust can be obtained by converting Enchanted Matter using tools. It can be obtained by helping in adventures on astral allods and by completing Distortions.

Amalgam can be acquired by converting Drops of Amalgam that are earned in Skirmishes, Tka-Rik's Cave, or obtained by completing special alchemical quests. Once you have all the components, use the Anvil of Artifacts. You will be able to create the insignia in the appropriate section. To upgrade a piece of equipment, use a Hero's Insignia on the item.

t:
No one but us blacksmiths can make plate armor. Also, we possess the art of forging rings. But first you'll have to practice making shields and various household implements.
Now, to the craft. Use a mobile forge to learn the list of blueprints available and prepare the right components. You can buy coal for your work from me. Use a pick to extract ore that should then be cast in the molds you need. As for rivets, chains, heeltaps and spikes, those can be obtained by fighting enemies.
The forging process is simple: you create five parts, check their quality, keep the good ones and reforge the rest. You can only reforge each part twice, and you work on at least two parts at a time.
If all parts are of equal quality, you'll get an item of that same quality. If the quality is uncommon, you'll even get two items. If not, you'll get the item anyway, but it won't be as good as it could be.
You'll gain experience for each item you craft. When you've gained enough experience, your skill level will increase and new blueprints will be available to you. The highest available skill level in blacksmithing equals your character level.
Keep in mind that, as your skill level increases, you only gain access to the simplest blueprints that allow making items for personal use. But there are other, more sophisticated and expensive blueprints that you'll have to buy or obtain by yourself. They will allow you to craft items for sale to other heroes, higher-level items or even relics. Also, we can create tools to work with equipment pieces and staples - you will need those at the highest development level.
By the way, if you ever need low-level components, you can use retroform that you can buy from me as well. Don't worry, a single vial will last for a while. Keep in mind, though, that retroform affects neither ore nor the goods made from it.
You will need a set of tools for your work. You can buy them all from me.

You can try making epic items or craft 2 to 3 uncommon items at a time, or you can choose the golden mean and get a pretty good chance to make rare items. Every blacksmith decides for himself as to which strategy to choose.

t:
That elven dame's fate was tragic. But then, what else can you expect when you're at the same time a genius and a great fool? However brilliant Celestine de Ardeur was, her obsession with Tep played a bad joke on her - the Summoner punished her severely for her failure and integrated her mind into the Pyramid control system.

Nihil's final breath of relief was heard by the Observatory. This is why she's doomed to go through her death over and over again until the Observatory is satisfied.

Initially, Thalos was just a statue created by Ionas. He was the symbol of the Games, the majestic Keeper of Fire. Now he is a living creature, a container of tremendous power and a vehicle for the dark god's evil will.

Thalos is just a small manifestation of Nihaz's power, so don't delude yourself... He can still easily destroy you. He razed the entire stadium to the ground in just three seconds. If it had not been for me and the Observatory, it would have happened in the real world and not in the dimensional pocket. Though hurry up - my power won't hold it back for too long.

The Observatory made its choice:

First Whirl: The Dead King.

Second Whirl: Kazul.

Third Whirl: Nihil.

Fourth Whirl: Thalos.
r461266.n: Who is hiding behind the Whirls now?

t:
Its possibilities are not known to me... yet. This place was born in the exact same moment as me. Just as I am beginning to unfold my wings, the Observatory is still expanding its horizons.

However, it already has one property that we may use. Every mighty opponent that any hero of Sarnaut had ever faced left its imprint in the world. Those imprints entice the Observatory. It wants to relive those moments over and over again, feel the taste of time, understand its course and its laws... The Observatory rewards those who can help it learn.

You will find four Whirls here, and each one conceals one enemy. How long each of them are going to stay there is a mystery to me. The Observatory might get bored and replace them by the next time you are back.

Elves of the de Doucer house were not the first ones to fall prey to vampirism. A long time ago, on allods so distant no one these days even knows of their existence, vampires were already terrorizing the honest folk.

Of course, there were those who opposed them. I think you will be glad to hear that eventually vampires were wiped out. The Observatory offers you to witness the last hours of one of the mightiest vampires of those times - Blood Father Kanaan.

This must be still fresh in your memory! The Observatory takes great fancy to Catherina's personal guard. Efficiency, loyalty, incredible power with a very elegant touch of classic magic.

I must admit this even makes me think of building my own mechanical guard... I promise they won't attempt to kill you.

If you want to witness the four elements of magitechnology once again - the second Whirl is at your disposal.

t:
This one's a mysterious story. Why this name was given to a Cyclops even though two of his predecessors were a different species, I have no idea. Maybe, a cross-species love affair? Anyway, Brainum's life was short but busy. He was smart enough to plunder ships of small princelings and stay uncaught. Just like a dragon, he used to hide his treasures in the empty halls of the Ancient Mound, where no living thing dared to come.

Eventually, his greed played an evil joke on him - the undead of the Mound, disturbed by Morrana, a goddess of death, took his soul. The goddess cursed him, and now he is doomed to guard his ancient gold until the end of times.

Or rather he was doomed - until certain heroes took him down to the bones.

Zayan de Desirae took particular interest in her! To an extent that I even sent him to examine her temple personally. It took him a long time to get back...

Euriala was the most beautiful creature, the embodiment of Elven values. She was considered the Goddess of Beauty. No one dared question her high status. Her talent in magic was outstanding. Her kindness and valor were matched only by her beauty.

It was her valor that led to her fall. She was on the front line when Nihaz attacked Sarnaut. She watched as the world descended into darkness. One by one, her comrades died in her arms. At some point, she was on her own in this confrontation. This was when Euriala hated the entire existence: she despised Nihaz, the Great Mages, and even Sarnaut's legendary heroes who got tangled up in the threads of time and failed to come to her aid.

Overflowing with rage, the perfect beauty turned into an abomination, as though this was the Dark God's joke.

The Observatory made its choice:

First Whirl: Kanaan, Blood Father.

Second Whirl: Clockwork Knight, Catherina's Guardian.

Third Whirl: Brainum the Third, Treasury Keeper.

Fourth Whirl: Eurial, Forgotten Goddess.

t: I've been waiting for this so long...

I don't see why people love this Well so much. The morning sun is a thousand times more beautiful, and you can see it from everywhere.

I'm a simple centaur. I'm not even a shaman who talks to spirits. I can't see the whole picture. Come to think of it, why is it even called "a well"? It's no good for collecting water. Oh heavens, it is a weird place, indeed.

While I was grabbing a bite, I overheard a conversation. They were talking about Demon Hunters whose camp they liberated from demons a while ago. They're so brave! They fly through astral and hunt astral monsters there. They've been everywhere. I decided I should pay them a visit and listen to their stories. I hear nature is very beautiful there.

My hooves are aching, but adventure is calling! No time for rest!
There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?

The note says:

I'm sorry to leave you, my friend, but the road's a-callin'.

Besides, even if I stay, will I manage to find a job in Polis?

You helped me see something. If you keep searching persistently, you're bound to find something. I didn't know that at first, but then I realized: you've got your purpose - live up to it. You should never care about what people think. It requires willpower. Above all, don't lose yourself while trying to reveal a secret!

Perhaps, you can catch up with me. If you're interested, I'm heading to the South of Dion Mountain Range, beyond the Pearl Slopes, to see the real demons people are talking about.
r483997.n: A-ha. Just hand me the note.
